name: Rain Bird Gardener's Drip Irrigation Kit
description: Rain Bird easy-to-use drip irrigation kit includes everything you need to water up to a 75-sq. ft. area. Kit conforms to your landscape with no digging or plumbing skills needed. Use the emitter tubing to water closely-spaced plantings and garden rows or the spot emitters for widely-spaced plantings. Multi-function faucet connection kit regulates pressure, filters sediment and prevents back flow. Covers 75 sq. ft. Kit Includes: -Faucet connection kit -50'L x 1/2"dia. emitter tubing -50'L x 1/2"dia. blank tubing -25'L x 1/4"dia. blank distribution tubing - (3) 1/2" barbed tees - (2) 1/2" barbed elbows - 1/2" end closure -10 galvanized stakes -(5) 1/4" barbed tees -(2) 1/4" barbed couplings -(2) 1/2" barbed couplings - (5) 1/4" tubing stakes -(10)1/4" tubing plugs -(5) 1.0-gph emitters and one emitter tool.
